meta.label: Earth-2 FourCastNet NIM connection
meta.description: Connection to a locally deployed NVIDIA Earth-2 FourCastNet NIM and the model version it serves.

params.name: base_url
params.label: NIM base URL
params.description: e.g. http://fourcastnet.nim-services.svc.cluster.local:8000 (prefer the in-cluster service URL; load balancer idle timeouts break long streams)

params.name: api_key
params.label: API key
params.description: Optional. Only if the NIM endpoint is protected (e.g. behind an API gateway). Leave empty for no authentication

params.name: api_key_header
params.label: API key header
params.description: HTTP header that carries the API key (e.g. X-API-Key)

params.name: model_id
params.label: Model
params.description: Must match the NIM image you deployed
